classification.rule: Candidate detects strictly more wrong rows than b_fixed and every old rule, with no more false positives than any comparator, on identical classifiable rows.

decisions.interpretation: All CAL is exposed development data. Passing is permission to consider an independent frozen confirmation, not confirmation itself; pairs sharing a trajectory are dependent.
decisions.status_basis: TRAIN-only matching is the primary development gate; strict TRAIN+CAL matching is reported as a post-label stratum.

limitations: All results are retrospective development diagnostics on previously exposed CAL.
A passed candidate gate is not independent validation or a deployable certificate.
The root reproduces the old reference separately; this script makes no reproduction assertion.
The producer is responsible for complete episode inventories when expected_episode_count is absent.

metric_conventions.correctness_positive_class: original Fine top2 equals current physical top2
metric_conventions.coverage: Per-method summaries use available vectors; all head-to-head gates use identical common coverage.
metric_conventions.score: lower is slower; six unordered gaps have equal weight
metric_conventions.top2_ties: exact equality at the second/third score boundary; abstain and count separately
metric_conventions.weighting: slot -> physical trajectory -> unordered seed pair; pairs and blocks are dependent within trajectory
metric_conventions.wrong_flag_confusion_mapping: Step6 TN = wrong detected; Step6 FN = correct falsely flagged
